pages.title: A Dimension That Seems Unobservable by the Time Government
pages.text: The White Night Garden does not naturally spawn any hostile mobs; it only spawns large numbers of ownerless Touken Danshi and animals.$(br2)Tsukimi-zakura petals fall year-round within the dimension, and dimension-exclusive Tsukimi-zakura trees also generate here.

pages.title: Moon Phase
pages.text: The White Night Garden must be entered by building a portal yourself and using the Moon Phase item on the Moon White Stone frame to open the portal.

pages.name: Portal Frame
pages.text: Build this portal, then use the Moon Phase item on the frame to open the portal passage.

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: By default, no hostile mob entities naturally spawn in this dimension, though it cannot be ruled out that other mods may bypass this mechanic.

pages.title: Dimension Difficulty
pages.text: The dimension's difficulty depends on the player's choices. When you choose to challenge this dimension's boss, White Mikazuki Munechika, the dimension's difficulty will increase.
